# layout

> layout checks a repo's tree against repo.layout, a contract that reads like a directory listing, and exits 1 on drift.

- [Site](https://zaydek.github.io/layout/): the pitch, an example contract and check run, install, the grammar
- [Setup prompt](https://zaydek.github.io/layout/setup.md): paste it into your coding agent to set layout up in a repo
- [This site as Markdown](https://zaydek.github.io/layout/index.md): the same page, for agents
- [README](https://github.com/zaydek/layout/blob/main/README.md): the grammar and the commands

## Grammar

```text
$component: [A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*
$hook:      use[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*
$code:      <=400

README.md                              # One: a plain name is exactly one file
package.json
?CHANGELOG.md                          # ? marks an entry optional
src/
  main.tsx
  components/
    $component.tsx $code               # Many: a pattern matches any number
    ?$component.test.tsx               # An optional test beside it        
  hooks/
    $hook.ts $code                     # A hoisted cap
public/
  {}                                   # Anything goes here
docs -> ../docs                        # A symlink
```



## Commands

```sh
layout .                   # Check this tree; exit 1 on drift
layout lint                # Check the contract's own syntax
layout format              # Rewrite the contract to house style
```
